pass: final editorial instructions (2026-11-02): exactly five flavour texts revised

changes.before: Rolled across the sea floor in one night and came back covered in every lost thing: rings, keys, a submarine's spare propeller. The lost property office now has a rock pool.
changes.after: Gave a sleeping whale one spiky prod in the tail. The whale leapt so high that it landed in a different ocean, and it now checks every rock very carefully before sitting down.

changes.before: Melted down and re-formed as a candle as tall as a tower block. The town uses it as a clock and goes to bed when it burns down to the next floor.
changes.after: Melted down and re-formed as a candle as tall as a tower block. Blowing it out takes every leaf blower in town, and they still have to make a wish first.

changes.before: Dunked itself in the reservoir and turned the town's water into tea. Everyone was very polite for a week.
changes.after: Swung on its own string like a wrecking ball and knocked the cake stand off every table at the village fete. Scones are still being found in the church bell tower.

changes.before: Won the garden show by standing perfectly still for nine days. The judges gave it best statue, best shrub and best tomato.
changes.after: Grew a whole prize garden on top of its hat in one night and entered the national flower show. It went home with best statue, best shrub, best tomato and, somehow, best dog.

changes.before: Balances on its pointy end on anything, even the roof of a moving bus.
changes.after: Balances on its pointy end on anything, even the roof of a moving bus. The driver now brakes very gently, just in case.
